_notes: Mirrors AJPH manuscript Table 1 exactly. detection_is_exceedance: reporting limit == MCL, so any detection counts as at/above threshold (PFOA/PFOS). true_exceedance: real MCL comparison (PFHxS/PFNA/HFPO-DA). hi_reference_no_exceedance: PFBS Hazard Index requires co-located multi-compound readings not retained in this dataset; do not report exceedance. evidence_reference_not_regulatory: Lithium has no federal MCL; 7.36 is a cohort-study reference concentration, not a regulatory threshold. no_reference: five remaining unregulated analytes, detection prevalence only.
